subject: general
question: The World Hindi day is celebrated annually on _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10th January**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Hindi Day** is celebrated annually on **10th January**.
 
• The day marks the anniversary of the first World Hindi Conference held in 1975, which was inaugurated by the then Prime Minister of India, Indira Gandhi.
 
• The aim of the conference was to promote the Hindi language worldwide.
 
• World Hindi Day is different from National Hindi Day, which is celebrated on 14th September to mark the adoption of Hindi as the official language of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindi** is the fourth most spoken language in the world, with over 260 million native speakers.
 
• Efforts are made by the Indian government and various organizations to promote Hindi globally through cultural events, academic programs, and media.
 
• The World Hindi Secretariat, established in Mauritius, works to promote the Hindi language worldwide.
 
• Various events, including literary festivals, poetry sessions, and language competitions, are organized on World Hindi Day to celebrate the language.
